Creating Patches

Generate unified diff patches to document and review code changes.

Overview

The createPatch tool generates standard unified diff patches for reviewing changes.

Basic Usage

{
  "tool": "createPatch",
  "parameters": {
    "before": "original code",
    "after": "modified code",
    "fileName": "Example.cs"
  }
}

Use Cases

Document Bug Fixes

{
  "before": "return users.First(u => u.Id == id);",
  "after": "return users.FirstOrDefault(u => u.Id == id);",
  "fileName": "UserService.cs"
}

Review Refactoring

{
  "before": "public void Process()\n{\n    // sync code\n}",
  "after": "public async Task ProcessAsync()\n{\n    // async code\n}",
  "fileName": "Processor.cs"
}

Understanding Patches

--- a/UserService.cs
+++ b/UserService.cs
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
 public User GetUser(int id)
 {
-    return users.First(u => u.Id == id);
+    return users.FirstOrDefault(u => u.Id == id);
 }

Integration with Other Tools

  1. Use applyFixes to generate changes
  2. Extract specific changes with createPatch
  3. Share patches for review
  4. Apply patches with git or patch tools
